name: @HolimaX/beerbank
description: Cloud Dashboard core framework. Foundation for the Personalized Cloud Dashboard (PCD) available for Pro/Premium Android users. Provides logic for CRUD operations and Okta-based synchronization.

scripts.start-nix: npm run git-info && cross-env REACT_APP_ENABLE_ADS="$npm_package_config_enableAds" REACT_APP_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID="$npm_package_config_gaMeasurementId" REACT_APP_PCD_PATH="$npm_package_config_pcdPath" REAPTCHA_SITE_KEY="$npm_package_config_reaptchaSiteKey" AUTHPROVIDERCID="$npm_package_config_authProviderCID" FULLVERSION="${npm_package_config_productFlavour}0.${npm_package_config_versionCode}.${npm_package_config_versionName}" react-scripts start
scripts.build-win: npm run git-info && cross-env REACT_APP_ENABLE_ADS=%npm_package_config_enableAds% REACT_APP_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID=%npm_package_config_gaMeasurementId% REACT_APP_PCD_PATH=%npm_package_config_pcdPath% REAPTCHA_SITE_KEY=%npm_package_config_reaptchaSiteKey% AUTHPROVIDERCID=%npm_package_config_authProviderCID% FULLVERSION=%npm_package_config_productFlavour%0.%npm_package_config_versionCode%.%npm_package_config_versionName% react-scripts build --verbose
scripts.build-nix: npm run git-info && marked-man ./README.md > ./man/beerbank.1 && cross-env REACT_APP_ENABLE_ADS="$npm_package_config_enableAds" REACT_APP_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID="$npm_package_config_gaMeasurementId" REACT_APP_PCD_PATH="$npm_package_config_pcdPath" REAPTCHA_SITE_KEY="$npm_package_config_reaptchaSiteKey" AUTHPROVIDERCID="$npm_package_config_authProviderCID" FULLVERSION="${npm_package_config_productFlavour}0.${npm_package_config_versionCode}.${npm_package_config_versionName}" react-scripts build --verbose
scripts.test: npm run git-info && cross-env REACT_APP_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID="$npm_package_config_gaMeasurementId" REACT_APP_PCD_PATH="$npm_package_config_pcdPath" react-scripts test --watchAll=false --coverage
